mysql.modes: Every lexical mode, parameter style and name interpretation supported at the baseline.

postgres.modes: UTF-8 and standard_conforming_strings on, every baseline parameter style and supported search path.

sqlite.modes: Every baseline parameter style, supported search path and language setting.

semanticFamilies: relations, columns and names in local, enclosing and external scopes
scalar and row values, literal types, functions, casts, operators, collations and parameter binding
select, joins, projection, distinctness, predicates, grouping, windows, ordering, limits and offsets
subqueries, compound selects, values and ordinary, recursive or data-modifying common tables
inserts, updates, deletes, dialect-specific mutations and returning clauses
schema declarations and changes, views, constraints, indexes and triggers
transactions, session state and all other statement families of each shipped grammar
requiredScope.coverageRule: Unregistered grammar forms, concrete roles, paths, modes and observations remain open. Grammar membership is a coverage input. It supplies no evidence of semantic implementation.

initialExecutableDomain.identifier: Any valid UTF-8 string up to 255 bytes without NUL. Comparison of reference names folds ASCII A-Z only. Result names preserve spelling.
initialExecutableDomain.externalInterpretation: The same schema-qualified table and named columns, with the same rows and SQLite storage values, are supplied at evaluation. The directly built source lists required columns as an external interface. Analysis establishes those names against a resolved complete base table declaration and does not publish the declaration.
initialExecutableDomain.projection: One SELECT with 1 to 2000 results and zero or one named source. ALL or the default bag behavior. No other SELECT clauses. A source can have an alias on input. Every result owns its observed output name. A nested binary arithmetic tree has height at most 32, with leaves at height zero. At most 8192 expanded expression nodes across the result list.
initialExecutableDomain.inputAnalysis: Accept the projection domain with explicit or derived result names, parentheses, signed decimal integer constants, NULL, numbered question markers, resolved column names and binary addition, subtraction and multiplication. Reject unsupported syntax or unresolved static meaning before returning this IR. A resolved column of the input source maps to a source slot. The analyzer requires a complete resolved base table declaration and references to its explicitly declared columns.
observations: SQLite storage classes and values including NULL
numbered parameter markers and their slots
plain SELECT has no data changes
no guaranteed row order in this domain

identifier.conditions: no NUL, valid UTF-8, up to 255 bytes
identifier.meaning: value with exact bytes, ASCII-folded only for identifier lookup
identifier.sql: double quotes around the bytes with doubled embedded double quotes

integer.sql: decimal digits with a leading minus for a negative value

parameter.structure: decimal label and its derived numeric slot
parameter.meaning: value supplied to that slot, preserving native name metadata when labels share a slot

column.role: reference to a column of the sole local source
column.conditions: nonnegative locally, indexes a present source column at SELECT boundary
column.meaning: that source row value, including its SQLite storage class
column.sql: fixed source alias, dot, source column identifier

arithmetic.structure: operator and ordered left and right closed expressions
arithmetic.conditions: SQLite addition, subtraction or multiplication, depth bounded at SELECT boundary
arithmetic.meaning: SQLite numeric coercion, NULL propagation and overflow rules
arithmetic.sql: parenthesized expression with the matching operator between its operands

operator.meaning: the SQLite operation in the selected language profile

source.role: external interface of the sole local source
source.conditions: closed list, no case-insensitive duplicate column names
source.meaning: one absolute table identity with named column inputs
source.sql: qualified table followed by a fixed correlation name

projection.conditions: expression of the supported value role
projection.meaning: the ordered expression value with that result name
projection.sql: expression followed by an explicit quoted AS alias

select.structure: nonempty ordered result list and optional source
select.conditions: result count, reference membership, expression height and expanded node count
select.meaning: one row without a source, or one result row per source row
select.sql: SELECT and ordered result columns, optionally FROM the source

acceptance.Q01: Exact closed shape and checked construction boundaries plus targeted negatives. Treat bypass via privileged Reflection or native extensions as outside PHP's regular construction API.
acceptance.Q02: Every positive in the independent finite domain and seeded exploration must construct. Record unverified language input separately.
acceptance.Q03: Closed operand unions and explicit scope checks. Verify constructor, traversal and rendering cases against the registry and mutation fixtures.
acceptance.Q04: A structural termination and emission argument plus independent real SQLite observations in the finite and seeded domains. Finite results are empirical evidence.
acceptance.Q05: Independent inventory, content digests, known mismatch checks, controlled runner and review of differences against a pinned baseline. Evidence from an unprotected run stays provisional.

finite.domain: For each source choice, no source or accounts, use every eligible atom in a single result and every ordered pair of eligible atoms under each operator in a single result. In addition, use every ordered pair of eligible atoms in two results. Slot atoms require a source.
finite.completeness: Compare observed structural case IDs one for one with an independent Cartesian product. Duplicates and missing IDs fail.

F03.fault: Swap the two fixture columns during emission

F04.fault: Remove readonly from the source column list

F05.fault: Add a retained source SQL property

F06.signal: independent result rows or names differ

F07.fault: Emit the left operand of arithmetic only

F08.fault: Return a strict subset of the finite cases
F08.signal: observed case IDs fail the Cartesian-product check

F10.fault: Skip a comparison after attempting a case
F10.signal: execution accounting reports a missing terminal event

F11.fault: Remove storage class from the observations

F12.fault: Modify a shipped file after evidence collection

trust: baseline parser and lowering during analysis
source audit and contract digest verifier
trusted runner configuration and artifact custody
formalProof: No machine-checked proof specified. Review the closed composition argument. Universal dialect fidelity and unimplemented scope remain open.
